messages:
maria: Quick pulse 1: we need final copy + routing rules for three launch pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Deadline EOD Thu so engineering can wire forms and UTM tracking. Keep mobile first.
ashley: Draft plan: single-sentence hero, 3 quick bullets, one micro-benchmark line, primary CTA = Register Webinar, secondary CTAs vary by page (Start Trial for Hosted, Request Quote for Dedicated/Private).
jon: Micro-benchmark ideas (short, human): Hosted -> ~50 ms median token latency on common open LLMs; Dedicated -> predictable reserved throughput (~5k tokens/sec on reserved pool); Private -> enterprise controls: SOC 2 + customer KMS + optional air-gapped deploy. No decimals.
kevin: For on-page phrasing, keep it very scannable e.g. "Hosted: fast API, transparent pricing"; "Dedicated: reserved pools, SLA-backed throughput"; "Private: audit-ready, customer-managed networking."
maria: Webinar CTA wording: "Register: Live demos + benchmark walkthroughs". Also add a single line under CTA: "See methodology for test rig and prompts" linking to short PDFs.
ashley: I'll prepare 3 hero variations per page (concise): A) "One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs." B) "Fast, predictable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private." C) "Ship LLM features with enterprise controls and flexible deployment." Which is best?
jon: A is the punchiest. Use C on Private page for trust nuance.
kevin: Routing: keep it deterministic. Ops can implement simple rules so leads don't bounce. Proposed form fields: email, company, company_size (small,mid,enterprise), primary_use_case, wants_private (checkbox), wants_dedicated (checkbox), wants_webinar, utm_source/medium/campaign. Also capture consent checkbox.
ops-bot: NOTE: webinar landing must send utm_campaign and utm_source to marketing events pipeline. Tagging rule: add "webinar_launch_may".
maria: Lead routing pseudocode (ops-friendly):
```
if wants_webinar == true:
  send_to: marketing-webinars@redwood.ai
  tag: webinar-signup
if company_size == 'enterprise' or request_quote == true:
  send_to: sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai
  tag: enterprise-lead
elif wants_dedicated == true and company_size in ['mid','enterprise']:
  send_to: solutions@redwood.ai
  tag: dedicated-interest
else:
  send_to: selfserve@redwood.ai
  tag: trial-or-eval
# always include utm fields and primary_use_case in payload
```
ashley: Nice. Also include a short routing hint on the page: "Enterprise? Request a quote and we'll fast-track your demo." That nudges enterprise users to the right CTA.
kevin: Benchmarks: I'll create 3 one-page PDFs with methodology, test rig, models used (families, quant), and sample prompts. On-site micro-benchmark lines should link to those PDFs with copy "see methodology".
maria: Add analytics expectations: dashboard should show webinar signups by page, conversion rate of CTA variants, and lead quality by company_size. Tag conversions with utm_campaign and creative_id.
ops-bot: Reminder: secure the webinar form with captcha + rate limiting. Also set webhook retry logic to avoid lost leads.
jon: Copy bullets under hero (exact text candidates): 1) "Unified REST & SDK API across hosted, dedicated, and private" 2) "Predictable unit economics and autoscaling controls" 3) "Enterprise-grade security and auditability"
maria: For Private page add trust line: "SOC 2, customer-managed VPC, optional on-prem deployment, KMS integrations." Link to compliance docs.
ashley: I'll upload the copy variants (hero A/B/C, three CTA options per page) to the Website Copy doc and flag preferred ones by Thu 11:00 PT.
kevin: I'll link the benchmark PDFs and a short ops checklist (form fields, routing, utm) here when ready.
maria: Final sign-off meeting Thu 14:00 PT. If engineering hits blockers implementing routing or webhook, loop @kevin and @maria immediately. :rocket:
